## Discrimination Tab

The Discrimination tab under the Product Editor contains datetime effective settings and is available when the user selects a date range from the product tree. Here the user can specify the number of decimal digits to be displayed or allowed for data entry for any of the listed fields. These values also control the number of decimal places displayed on reports for these fields.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" />

When these fields are viewed in the Volume Editor, Ticket Editor and Ticket Search, values will be displayed per the defined discrimination values. Data entry is also limited for fields based on the discrimination level.

If the **Apply Discrimination in Calculations** option is checked, values used in liquid calculations on meter batches and tickets are rounded per the discrimination on the product selected before any calculations are performed; otherwise, values are used at full precision

The discrimination level specified for meter factor defines where it will be rounded for use in the calculation of the CCF. This rounding occurs regardless of whether the Apply Discrimination in Calculations option is checked or not.

CCF = Round(meter factor,x) \* Round(CTL,y) \* Round(CPL,z)

where: x, y and z are discrimination levels defined in the Product editor for each field

The discrimination level specified for CCF defines where it will be rounded for use in the calculation of Gross Standard Volume (GSV) from Indicated Volume (IV). If the CCF discrimination is set to unused, GSV will be calculated from an unrounded CCF. This rounding occurs regardless of whether the Apply Discrimination in Calculations option is checked or not.

GSV = IV \* Round(CCF, w)

Where: w is the discrimination level defined in the Product Editor for CCF

Volume discrimination levels define discrimination for all volumes, including IV, GSV, NSV, SWV, Theoretical Production, component volume, and component net allowable volumes.
